say:4:1224504003:1.source_cn: 你们提她干嘛？她早就和我没关系了。

say:10:1224506006:1.source_cn: 不过这事要想真正解决，光劝她是没用的。但我有办法！这事...

say:11:1224506007:0.text: Let's head to the <style="highlight">port</style>. I'm sure she's there staring at the ships.

say:4:1224507002:0.text: Shoot it if you've got something to say. Otherwise, just get lost.

say:7:1224507005:1.text: Aren't you weird? You turned down the chance yourself, yet you're acting like you've been rejected.
say:7:1224507005:1.source_cn: 你这人太奇怪了，明明是你自己拒绝了，却像是被拒绝了一样伤心。

say:8:1224507006:1.text: You're right. I don't understand myself either.
say:8:1224507006:1.source_cn: 是啊，我也搞不懂我自己。

say:10:1224507008:1.text: You had it with you the day you came back from the sea.

say:11:1224507009:1.text: You have a great memory! Now, who promised to be my first mate back then? And why are you acting like this now?

say:14:1224507012:1.source_cn: 泰西欧已经受到了审判，血薇帮也证明了老爹他们的清白。

say:15:1224507013:1.text: Although both our fathers can never return, I'm sure my old man had no regrets about sacrificing his life for his passion.
say:15:1224507013:1.source_cn: 虽然你和我的父亲都不会再回来了，但为自己热爱的事业奉献...

say:16:1224507014:1.text: Given how common it is for sailors to die at sea, your father must have prepared you for the day.
say:16:1224507014:1.source_cn: 出航的水手死在海里——这事太常见了，你父亲肯定和你打过...

say:17:1224507015:1.text: I bet you just can't accept that he was killed by a villain instead of by the waves.
say:17:1224507015:1.source_cn: 你只是不能接受他不是死在航海冒险上，而是被一个小人所害。

say:19:1224507017:1.text: Tell me the truth—did you join the Carmine Whispers to gather evidence against Tesio?
say:19:1224507017:1.source_cn: 喂，你老实说，你当年加入血薇帮是不是为了寻找泰西欧的罪证？

say:20:1224507018:1.text: I doubt you contributed nothing to Tesio's trial.
say:20:1224507018:1.source_cn: 要说对泰西欧的公审里你没出一点力，我反正不信。

say:21:1224507019:1.text: You can say anything you want.

say:22:1224507020:1.text: I know you too well to need an answer.

say:23:1224507021:1.text: Listen to me—it's not our fault that we failed to convince our fathers to stay...
say:23:1224507021:1.source_cn: 醒一醒吧，当年，你没劝下你父亲，我没劝下我老爹……这都...

say:24:1224507022:1.text: Even if we clung ourselves to their legs and cried our hearts out, they'd just shake us off and leave to find the treasure that Tesio claimed could save Rustport.
say:24:1224507022:1.source_cn: 就算咱们都抱着他们的大腿哭，他们也会甩开，然后带着船队...

say:25:1224507023:0.text: Nothing could have talked them out of venturing the waters, and you know it.
say:25:1224507023:0.source_cn: 他们就是这样的人，你知道的，没什么能拦下他们一次次迎击...

say:26:1224507024:1.source_cn: 你该放过你自己了，贝拉。

say:28:1224507026:1.text: Why are you so quiet? I remember you used to be quite chatty.
say:28:1224507026:1.source_cn: 怎么又不说话了……我记得你小时候话挺多的啊？

say:32:1224507031:1.text: Now, here's a sea chart drawn by your father, which was left at my place before they departed. Unfortunately, it's in bad shape now.
say:32:1224507031:1.source_cn: 我也懒得说那么多了。这有一份海图，是你父亲画的，他们离...

say:33:1224507032:1.text: If you're ready to go sailing, you can meet me on the ship. You know where it's docked, don't you?
say:33:1224507032:1.source_cn: 如果你愿意出海，我会在船上等你。你知道血薇帮把船停在哪吧？

say:35:1224507034:1.text: See ya! I'll be waiting for you, my first mate!

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 辛巴达说的对，你该放下了

say:38:1224507029:1.text: Exactly. There's a reason he passed on so many sailing skills to you.
say:38:1224507029:1.source_cn: 就是这个道理。要不然，他也不会教你这么多航海技巧了。

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 你父亲一定希望你能继承他的事业
